315 Dishes Your Family Will Love Home cooks, rejoice! Best of Betty Crocker is packed with more recipes than ever before! From savory starters and satisfying entrees to delicious desserts and gifts from the kitchen, you'll find the perfect recipes for every event, whether it's a comfy weeknight at home or a celebration with family and friends. In this handy cookbook, Betty Crocker serves up all-time American classics and takes your taste buds on new adventures, all with step-by-step instructions and gorgeous glossy photos. We have even included hundreds of Betty's kitchen hints to help ensure that all your dishes are a feast for the palate and the eyes. For generations, family cooks have looked to Betty Crocker for inspiration and advice, and this book carries on the tradition. Won't you join us in the kitchen today?
